title: SparseHPS: A Unified Model for Human Pose and Shape across Depth Cameras and LiDARs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recovering 3D human pose and shape from point clouds is central to motion capture, robotics and self-driving vehicles, because depth cameras and LiDARs sense a person directly in metric 3D and work under any lighting. However, current approaches are each tailored to one sensor type: point density differs by more than ten times between devices, public datasets are labeled with incompatible body models, and LiDAR approaches need long input sequences to offset sparse scans. In this work, we present SparseHPS, a novel sensor-agnostic network that recovers SMPL-X pose, shape and global translation from a human point cloud with one set of weights, for single frames and streams alike. Specifically, SparseHPS encodes the cloud with a LitePT backbone over sparse voxels, represents every joint by a learnable query decoded with one common head, localizes the body by voting over voxels, and draws temporal context from a causal memory of tokens fro

translated_title: SparseHPS：跨深度相机与激光雷达的人体姿态与形状统一模型
translated_abstract: 从点云中恢复三维人体姿态与形状是动作捕捉、机器人和自动驾驶汽车的核心任务，因为深度相机和激光雷达能够以真实的米制三维直接感知人体，并且可以在任意光照条件下工作。然而，现有的方法各自只针对一种传感器类型：不同设备之间的点密度相差十倍以上，公开数据集采用互不兼容的人体模型进行标注，而且激光雷达方法需要较长的输入序列来弥补稀疏扫描的不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了SparseHPS，一种新颖的传感器无关网络，它使用同一套权重即可从人体点云中恢复SMPL-X姿态、形状和全局平移，对单帧和流式输入均适用。具体而言，SparseHPS使用LitePT骨干网络在稀疏体素上编码点云，用可学习的查询表示每个关节并通过一个统一的解码头进行解码，通过在体素上投票来定位人体，并从先前帧令牌的因果记忆中获取时序上下文……
tldr: 提出首个传感器无关的统一模型SparseHPS，仅需一套权重即可从深度相机或激光雷达采集的人体点云中恢复SMPL-X三维人体姿态、形状与全局平移，同时适用于单帧和视频流输入。
en_tdlr: SparseHPS is a sensor-agnostic unified model that recovers SMPL-X pose, shape, and global translation from human point clouds captured by either depth cameras or LiDARs using a single set of weights, for both single frames and streams.
